        <div>
          <p class="exp-title">Training & Content Design Analytics Intern</p>
          <p class="exp-meta">Hyundai Capital America</p>
        </div>
        <span class="exp-dates"><span>06/2026-08/2026</span><span>Irvine, CA</span></span>
      </div>
<ul class="exp-bullets">
        <li>Audited the department's master STP Tracker for 2026, the central system used to log every training delivered across the company, identifying duplicate entries, structural errors, and inconsistent performance benchmarks across hundreds of logged trainings spanning eLearning and Instructor-Led Training (ILT) formats.</li>
        <li>Mapped the relationship between Jira, where new trainings are logged at the request stage, and the master tracker, where training details were re-entered by hand, to establish standardized naming conventions and primary/foreign key relationships between the two systems.</li>
        <li>Designed an automated Excel workflow in which new training requests from Jira and participant performance data from individual department workbooks would populate the standardized tracker with minimal manual entry, replacing a fully manual, copy-paste-driven process.</li>
        <li>Architected a suite of Tableau dashboards on top of the standardized tracker to give leadership real-time visibility into training completion, participation, and performance trends by department, replacing the static, manually compiled summaries previously in use.</li>
        <li>Built a rollout plan to onboard my manager and department staff onto the new system, including a summary report, a quick-reference cheat sheet, a webinar series, and hands-on workshops.</li>
        <li>Presented and demonstrated the standardized tracker and Tableau dashboards to HCA executives, department heads, managers, and the intern cohort as the capstone deliverable of the summer internship program.</li>
      </ul>
      <p class="exp-skills"><strong>Soft Skills Developed:</strong> Enterprise Data Restructuring, Workflow Automation, Training Program Design, Data Visualization, Executive Presentations</p>
      <p class="exp-skills"><strong>Software Used:</strong> Excel, Jira, Tableau, SharePoint</p>
    </div>

    <div class="exp-bar" id="ducks">
      <div class="exp-header">
        <div>
          <p class="exp-title">Student Business Data Analyst</p>
          <p class="exp-meta">Anaheim Ducks Hockey Club</p>
        </div>
        <span class="exp-dates"><span>01/2026-06/2026</span><span>Irvine, CA</span></span>
      </div>
      <ul class="exp-bullets">
        <li>Served as analysis lead for a five-person team, owning the project end-to-end from data extraction and dashboard development through final reporting and executive presentation, while coordinating biweekly meetings with Ducks and Rinks client stakeholders and our UCI faculty advisors.</li>
        <li>Designed and executed SQL queries in SSMS against the DASH (Rinks) and Archtics (Ticketmaster) schemas to build five analysis-ready datasets covering LTP registration records, 12-month cohort retention, pre/post-enrollment program participation, post-LTP program sequencing, and ticket sales crossover, applying client-defined business logic including revenue calculations across primary and secondary market channels.</li>
        <li>Built eight dashboard pages across three core analyses (ALTP Registration, ALTP &amp; Program Retention, and ALTP Ticket Sales Crossover) for 1,285 LTP participants, using DAX and Power Query to support dynamic year-over-year KPI cards, cohort retention line charts, a ranked post-LTP program sequence analysis, and both calendar and fiscal year views aligned to the Ducks' June 30 fiscal year end.</li>
        <li>Delivered recommendations to formalize a structured post-LTP off-ramp experience, deploy a post-completion participant survey, and implement demographic-targeted ticket marketing, with the dashboards serving as the ongoing measurement tool for initiative success.</li>
      </ul>
      <p class="exp-skills"><strong>Soft Skills Developed:</strong> Team Leadership, Data Modeling, Cohort Analysis, Retention Analysis, Descriptive Analytics, Marketing Analytics</p>
      <p class="exp-skills"><strong>Software Used:</strong> SQL, SSMS, Power BI, DAX, Power Query</p>

      <ul class="exp-bullets">
        <li>Directed food security initiatives including CalFresh Assistance Appointments, Fresh Finances, CalFresh Enrollment Parties, and large-scale events such as UCI Orientation, Celebrate UCI, and the Mobile Pantry Grand Opening; managed end-to-end logistics including venue coordination, catering, transportation, and day-of execution in partnership with UCI Student Services, UCI Transportation, and Orange County Social Services.</li>
        <li>Scheduled and managed 100–200 monthly CalFresh Assistance Appointments using Acuity Scheduling, coordinating staff availability, adjusting for cancellations, and ensuring consistent appointment coverage; managed all CalFresh communications including the program email inbox, student-facing outreach, departmental and partner correspondence, and semi-weekly personalized SAR7 and RE deadline reminders segmented by applicant type.</li>
